topic: The app mirrors orchd's 'relaxed' rule to decide what to confirm
detail: EnforcementSwitch.relaxes(to:) in macos/Sources/OrchKit/Spaces.swift treats 'off' (every layer) and the guard's 'log' as relaxing, matching internal/spaces Layer.Relaxed today. If orchd adds a relaxing state, the app would switch to it without asking. A per-state relaxed flag in EnforcementSwitch (orchd.proto; lane C owns proto) would remove the copy. Also a step down that still enforces (guard strict -> block-other-jobs) is sent without confirmation, by the same definition (security audit, informational).
